raw_output_excerpt: Todo Jobs is a web application designed to help users manage and track their job applications. Users can add, edit, and delete job entries, as well as categorize and add notes to application. When a user adds a note to a job application, the system records the note and allows the user to view it the application details. The application also supports user authentication through Google, enabling users to sign in and access their job application data securely.
